def components(grid, bg):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    out = []

            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            for y, x in q:
                cells.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx))
                        q.append((yy,xx))
            out.append((color, cells))
    return out

def is_corner_marker(cells):
    rs = [r for r, c in cells]
    cs = [c for r, c in cells]
    r0, r1, c0, c1 = min(rs), max(rs), min(cs), max(cs)
    # A thin L: one complete bounding-box edge in each perpendicular direction,
    # meeting at a corner, with no extra cells.
    corners = [

        {(r,c0) for r in range(r0,r1+1)} | {(r1,c) for c in range(c0,c1+1)},
        {(r,c1) for r in range(r0,r1+1)} | {(r0,c) for c in range(c0,c1+1)},
        {(r,c1) for r in range(r0,r1+1)} | {(r1,c) for c in range(c0,c1+1)},
    ]

    return next((s0 for s0 in corners if s0 == s), None)
